info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Loyalty Points Expires-v4-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Expiration API allows users to retrieve information about loyalty points that are nearing expiration. This service is essential for hotel loyalty program members to manage and utilize their points effectively before they expire. By accessing this endpoint, typical users, such as customers and loyalty managers, can receive timely notifications about their points status. The API supports various queries related to loyalty points, empowering businesses to enhance customer engagement and retention strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve the expiration information of points.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details about the expiration of points earned by users. It provides essential information related to when and how points will expire, helping users manage their points effectively.
